UNBOUND_SPONSOR_BODY: Unbound is free and built in the open. Sponsor it on GitHub to keep it going, and from $5 a month get your own badge on your Discord profile, shown to everyone using Unbound.
UNBOUND_SYNC_SIGN_IN_DESC: You must sign in with Discord to use this feature. Sync keeps your addons and settings the same on every device.
UNBOUND_SPONSOR_PERKS_PRICE: Sponsor Unbound for $5 a month on GitHub to unlock:
UNBOUND_SPONSOR_PERK_BADGE_DESC: Your own badge on your Discord profile, shown to everyone using Unbound. Animated GIFs work too.
UNBOUND_SPONSOR_BADGE_DESC: A custom badge from sponsoring Unbound, shown to everyone using Unbound.
UNBOUND_SPONSOR_PERK_ROLE_DESC: A Sponsor role in the Unbound Discord server.
UNBOUND_PLUGIN_NOT_RUNNING: This plugin is not running, so its settings are closed. Turn it back on to change them.
UNBOUND_ACCOUNT_SIGN_IN_DESC: Keeps your addons and settings in sync and unlocks sponsor perks.
UNBOUND_ACCOUNT_SIGN_IN_FAILED_DESC: Couldn't reach Unbound. Try again later.
UNBOUND_ACCOUNT_SIGN_OUT_CONFIRM: Sign out of {name}? Sync stops on this device. Your addons and settings stay as they are.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_SIGN_IN_DESC: Keep your addons and settings the same on every device. Only install links and settings are stored, never addon files.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_DELETE_CONFIRM: This deletes your synced addons and settings from the Unbound servers and turns Sync off on this device. Nothing installed on your devices is removed.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_MODE_TWO_WAY_DESC: Changes on any device reach every other one.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_MODE_DOWNLOAD_DESC: This device mirrors the cloud. Changes made here are replaced.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_MODE_UPLOAD_DESC: The cloud mirrors this device. Changes from other devices are replaced.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_CHOICE: Your cloud already has a setup
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_CHOICE_DESC: Choose how to combine it with this device. Nothing syncs until you pick.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_CHOICE_MERGE_DESC: Keep addons from both. The cloud's settings win where they differ.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_CHOICE_PULL_DESC: Replace this device's addons and settings.
UNBOUND_CLOUD_SYNC_CHOICE_PUSH_DESC: Replace what is stored in the cloud.
UNBOUND_RECOVERY_MODE_DESC: Prevents all addons from loading while enabled.
UNBOUND_RESTART_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to restart the app?
UNBOUND_INSTALL_URL_HINT: Enter the URL of the addon manifest you want to install.
UNBOUND_UPDATES_NOTIFY_DESC: Show a toast when updates are available.
UNBOUND_UPDATES_NOTIFY_TITLE: {count, plural, one {# update available} other {# updates available}}
UNBOUND_UPDATES_LOADER_REQUIRED_DESC: Newer Unbound updates need loader v{required}. You have v{installed}.
UNBOUND_UPDATES_LOADER_REQUIRED_IPA: Newer Unbound updates need an IPA update.
UNBOUND_UPDATES_LOADER_REQUIRED_TWEAK: Newer Unbound updates need a tweak update.
UNBOUND_UPDATES_LOADER_REQUIRED_APK: Newer Unbound updates need an APK update.
UNBOUND_UPDATES_LOADER_REQUIRED_MODULE: Newer Unbound updates need a module update.
UNBOUND_UPDATES_AVAILABLE_DESC: Tap an update to read what changed.
UNBOUND_DISCORD_NO_BUILDS: No builds are published for this channel yet
UNBOUND_DISCORD_ALLOW_INSTALLS_DESC: Turn on Allow from this source so Discord can install its own updates.
UNBOUND_DISCORD_UNSUPPORTED: This Discord predates in-app updates. Update it once with Obtainium.
UNBOUND_DISCORD_VERSIONS_DESC: Install any build, newer or older, without uninstalling.
UNBOUND_DISCORD_CONFIRMING: Confirm the update in the system prompt
UNBOUND_DISCORD_DOWNGRADE_DESC: Discord {version} is older than the one you have. Older versions can lose settings or sign you out, and Discord may ask you to update.
UNBOUND_VERSION_CONFIRM_HOLD: Automatic updates for {name} pause until you update it.
UNBOUND_VERSION_CONFIRM_DOWNGRADE: This is older than the installed v{installed}. Settings made by newer versions may not carry over.
UNBOUND_VERSION_CONFIRM_BROKEN: {names} need a different version and may stop working.
UNBOUND_VERSION_HELD_TOAST: {name} stays on v{version}. Tap Update to resume.
UNBOUND_MARKETPLACE_ERROR: Couldn't reach the marketplace. Pull down to try again.
UNBOUND_MARKETPLACE_REFRESH_FAILED: Couldn't refresh. Showing the last saved copy.
UNBOUND_STORE_PAGE_MISSING: This version has no store page.
UNBOUND_LINK_OFFLINE: Couldn't reach the marketplace to look up {id}.
UNBOUND_LINK_ALREADY_INSTALLED: {name} is already installed and up to date.
UNBOUND_SETTING_NOT_A_URL: Enter a link starting with http:// or https://.
UNBOUND_SETTING_DUPLICATE: That is already in the list.
UNBOUND_SETTING_TOO_SHORT: Enter at least {minLength, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
UNBOUND_FONTS_HINT: Every weight of a group follows its font.
UNBOUND_FONTS_INSTALL_HINT: A Google Fonts name, a font page link, or a .ttf, .otf or .zip link.
UNBOUND_FONTS_INSTALL_COUNT: Install {count, plural, one {# style} other {# styles}}
UNBOUND_FONTS_INSTALLED_TOAST: Installed {count, plural, one {# style} other {# styles}} of {family}.
UNBOUND_FONTS_PRESET_PASTE_INVALID: The clipboard holds no font preset.
UNBOUND_FONTS_PRESET_COPIED_DROPPED: Copied {name} without {families}: local fonts can't be shared.
UNBOUND_FONTS_PRESET_APPLIED_PARTIAL: Applied {name}: {unavailable} unavailable, {skipped} no longer in Discord.
UNBOUND_CHAT_BACKGROUND_THEME_HINT: Shows the image the applied theme recommends.
UNBOUND_CHAT_BACKGROUND_NO_THEME_HINT: The applied theme doesn't recommend an image.
UNBOUND_DEBUG_ENTITLEMENTS_FAILED: Entitlements.xml could not be attached, so the debug info was sent as text.
UNBOUND_THEME_RESTART_CONFIRM: Restart now so the theme applies everywhere?
UNBOUND_FFI_CONSENT_BODY: {name} wants to call native functions directly. A plugin with this access can read and change anything in Discord, and a mistake in it can crash the app. Only allow it if you trust where it came from.
UNBOUND_CRASH_REPORTS_DESCRIPTION: When a plugin crashes, freezes or fails to start, send its id and version, the Unbound and Discord versions, your device model and the last lines of Unbound's log to the Unbound team. Tokens, passwords and email addresses are removed from the log first, but anything a plugin logged can be in it. Your account is never included.
UNBOUND_SHARE_PICK: {count, plural, one {Send # file to} other {Send # files to}}
UNBOUND_SHARE_ADDED: {count, plural, one {Attached # file} other {Attached # files}} in {destination}. Add a message and send.
UNBOUND_SHARE_UNREADABLE: Discord can't open the shared files.
UNBOUND_SHARE_NO_DESTINATIONS: There's no recent channel or DM to share to.
UNBOUND_CRASH_DESCRIPTION: Discord or one of your plugins hit an error. Try again, reload, or start in recovery mode with every plugin off.
UNBOUND_REINSTALL_UNCHANGED: {name} already matches the store, or isn't published there.
UNBOUND_DELETE_BODY: Its files are removed from this device.
UNBOUND_DELETE_LIBRARY_BODY: {count, plural, one {# plugin needs it} other {# plugins need it}} and will stop working without it: {names}.
UNBOUND_DELETE_LIBRARY_AND_DEPENDENTS: {count, plural, one {Delete it and # plugin} other {Delete it and # plugins}}
UNBOUND_DELETED_WITH_DEPENDENTS: {count, plural, one {Deleted {name} and # plugin that needed it.} other {Deleted {name} and # plugins that needed it.}}
UNBOUND_DEPENDENCIES_BODY: {count, plural, one {Install # plugin first?} other {Install # plugins first?}}
UNBOUND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATE: {affected, plural, =0 {• Update {name} to {version}} one {• Update {name} to {version}, which # other plugin also uses} other {• Update {name} to {version}, which # other plugins also use}}
UNBOUND_DEPENDENCIES_UNAVAILABLE: The marketplace has no version that fits: {names}. Nothing was installed.
UNBOUND_DEPENDENCY_FAILED: Couldn't install {name}, so the plugin wasn't installed.
UNBOUND_DEVELOPER_MODE_ENABLE_RESTART: Developer mode loads a larger build with the debugger and live plugin reload. Performance may be affected. Unbound needs to restart to switch.
UNBOUND_DEVELOPER_MODE_DISABLE_RESTART: Unbound needs to restart to switch back to the standard build.
UNBOUND_TOASTS_PREVIEW_CONTENT: This is how your toasts will look.
UNBOUND_TOASTS_BLUR_HINT: Blur shows once opacity is below 100%.
UNBOUND_TOASTS_BEHAVIOR_HINT: Unlimited shows every toast at once. Indefinite keeps a toast until you close it.
UNBOUND_DEBUGGER_ENABLED_DESC: Connects to a debugger on your computer at launch.
UNBOUND_LOADER_RESTART_HINT: The loader reads these at launch. Restart from General to apply them.
UNBOUND_LOADER_CUSTOM_BUNDLE_DESC: Load Unbound from this URL instead of the release build. Reset to go back to the release build.
UNBOUND_LOADER_CUSTOM_BUNDLE_INVALID: Enter an http or https URL.
UNBOUND_LOADER_HOT_RELOAD_DESC: Reloads as soon as a newer bundle downloads, instead of on the next launch.
UNBOUND_LOADER_UNSIGNED_DESC: Skips the bundle signature check. Only use this with a bundle you trust.
UNBOUND_LOADER_DEVTOOLS_DESC: Connects to React DevTools at launch.
UNBOUND_ERROR_BOUNDARY_DESC: Shows a recovery screen instead of crashing when a screen fails to render.
UNBOUND_ERROR_BOUNDARY_TEST_ERROR: This is a test of the error boundary.
UNBOUND_COMMAND_EVAL_DESC: Evaluate JavaScript and show the result
UNBOUND_COMMAND_EVAL_SEND_DESC: Send the result to the channel
UNBOUND_COMMAND_RECOVERY_DESC: Turn recovery mode on or off and restart
UNBOUND_COMMAND_DEBUGGER_DESC: Turn the WebSocket debugger on or off, or connect it to an address
